name: FULL Agentic Patterns Kit 🧠
description_md:
# What You Get

- Direct link to the Agentic Design Patterns README with all 20+ patterns (Core, Advanced, System, Optimization, Strategic).

- Mermaid Diagrams folder: plain-English flowcharts for each pattern—zero jargon, instantly scannable.

- Pattern Discussions folder: when to use, where it fits, pros/cons, and implementation notes.

- ASCII Art Diagrams folder: text-based visuals ready to paste into docs, tickets, or Miro.

- Quick-start for every pattern: a visual, a simple explanation, real-world use cases, and build tips.

- Popular patterns at a glance: Prompt Chaining, Routing, Parallelization, Reflection, Tool Use, RAG, Multi-Agent Collaboration, Guardrails/Safety, Evaluation & Monitoring, Prioritization, and more.

- MIT License: use freely in client projects, internal wikis, or training material.

- Open to contributions: suggest improvements or new patterns via issues/PRs.
Join my Early AI-dopters Community for exclusives: https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
